description: quartermaster worker rules. Each hook runs qm hook <name> and exits quietly when qm is not on PATH.

hooks.command: command -v qm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec qm hook read-budget
command -v qm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec qm hook raw-launch-gate
command -v qm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec qm hook explorer-model
command -v qm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec qm hook reviewer-model
command -v qm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec qm hook lsp-note
command -v qm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec qm hook write-note
command -v qm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec qm hook context-limit
command -v qm >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec qm hook reviewer-model
